'''2008 Dantooine Regionals''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG regional championship played on Saturday 21 June 2008 at Game Domain, 1348 West Washington Suite 9, Stephenville, Texas, organized by [[Bobby Hilburn|Bobby Hilbun]] of Team Stephenville.<ref name="sf-20909-302110">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=302110#p302110 THE 2008 Dantooine Regionals Inquiry thread], Cyrusmorner (Bobby Hilbun), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (15 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125183658/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20909.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-20909-304536">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=304536#p304536 THE 2008 Dantooine Regionals Inquiry thread], Asphalizo, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (30 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125183658/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20909.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]] listed a first place at the event among his 2008 results, and [[Blake Huffman]] wrote a tournament report on finishing second.<ref name="sf-20869-317096">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=317096#p317096 Louisana States], mr007agent (Michael Richards), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (22 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125183525/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20869.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-21635-311852">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=311852#p311852 tournament reports, etc], Throdo (Jonathan Murray), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (2 July 2008).</ref> The two byes into Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship|World Championship]] went to [[Bryan Batdorf]] and Huffman.<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008).</ref>

== Organization ==

On 15 May 2008 Hilbun, posting as Cyrusmorner, proposed the date and store after talking with Cedric Simon; entry would be free, with deck registration from 11 am.<ref name="sf-20909-302110" /> On 30 May the event was confirmed as official, with decklists required and four or six games depending on attendance,<ref name="sf-20909-304536" /> and Hilbun confirmed the next day that six games would be played.<ref name="sf-20909-304749">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=304749#p304749 THE 2008 Dantooine Regionals Inquiry thread], Cyrusmorner (Bobby Hilbun), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (31 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125183658/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20909.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Game Domain, 1348 West Washington Suite 9, Stephenville, Texas<ref name="sf-20909-302110" />
* '''Dates:''' 21 June 2008<ref name="sf-20909-302110" /><ref name="sf-20909-304536" />
* '''Time:''' deck registration from 11:00 am<ref name="sf-20909-304536" />
* '''Format:''' constructed, six games; decklists required<ref name="sf-20909-304536" /><ref name="sf-20909-304749" />
* '''Entry fee:''' free<ref name="sf-20909-302110" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Bobby Hilburn|Bobby Hilbun]]<ref name="sf-20909-302110" />

== Results ==

No standings were posted in the event's forum topic. On 22 July 2008 Richards listed "Dantooine Regionals - 1st" among his results of the year.<ref name="sf-20869-317096" /> A list of tournament reports posted on 2 July 2008 included a second-place report on the event by Huffman, on DeckTech.<ref name="sf-21635-311852" /> The Players Committee's list of 2008 Day 2 bids gives the regional's two bids to Batdorf and Huffman.<ref name="sf-22883-332133" />
